Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Suresh - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Suresh stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan bursts out laughing.]

Shalini: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan starts crying.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan smiles at Mother.]

Ishaan: "What happened?"

[Ishaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Shalini: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan gets frightened and steps back.]

Ishaan: "Dad, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Suresh stand near him.]

Suresh: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan opens his umbrella.]

Ishaan (softly): "That was fun!"

[Ishaan puts on his raincoat.]

Suresh (happily): "This is amazing!"

[The rain stops.]

Suresh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
